children: Kraft Heinz reorganized its reporting into three operating segments and provided supplemental historical segment financials to conform prior periods to the new structure.
Combined West & East Emerging Markets and Asia Emerging Markets into a single Emerging Markets segment to increase efficiencies and drive growth.
Moved certain European countries from the former WEEM segment into Europe and Pacific Developed Markets as part of the reorganization.
Now reports three reportable segments: North America; Europe and Pacific Developed Markets; and Emerging Markets (previously two main reportable regions).
Filed Exhibit 99.1 with supplemental historical segment and non-GAAP reconciliations; changes have no impact on previously reported consolidated financial statements.
Provided segment-level metrics (net sales, Organic Net Sales, Segment Adjusted Operating Income) for fiscal years and quarters to aid comparability under the new structure.
